blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Team Philippines enters another day of competition in the 2026 Asian Games on Sunday, September 27. Tennis and men’s volleyball action get underway, while weightlifting gets its final shot at adding to the Philippines’ medal haul in Aichi-Nagoya. The Philippines also gets another crack at its first athletics medal, with several athletes competing in event finals.
